notablePrerequisites:
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five enchantments.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, untapping Sanctum Weaver and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
